## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 22, 2026 - Sep 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _zjstudios_, Sep 23, 2026, 1/5: "Look, I don’t review often. I have been tracking my food with my fitness pal for over 8 years. When they put food scanning behind the paywall, I knew it wasn’t going to end well. The interface layouts keep getting worse, features are buggy, food will randomly not track, and now my custom meals just don’t work and I waste so much time. It would actually be easier to track my food on a piece of paper and add it on a calculator. Fix your app guys."
            2. _JeffACrabtree_, Sep 23, 2026, 1/5: "The forced AI is garbage. No way to turn any of it off. And it constantly pops up notifications and reminders and just makes the user experience awful. Might have to cancel my subscription and look in to alternatives, such as MacrosFirst or Cronometer."
            3. _lovelyorangelady_, Sep 23, 2026, 3/5: "I have been an avid user of this app for the past couple of years. I will say the interface is easy to use, but within the last few months there have been features that were originally free now hidden behind a paywall. this is absolutely ridiculous that I cannot set my own macro goals and that they HAVE to be on a set amount. I understand that some features need to be paid for, but this is just made me not want to use the app. Absolutely ridiculous."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Sep 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Honest, not rude_, Sep 20, 2026, 1/5: "This app used to be great and the free version was doable for people who didn’t have the money. Unfortunately it seems like the company went for a money grab and now there’s ads every-time I open, log or look up an item. So many ads that it blocks the function of the app and freezes the screen. Happily moving to an app with less greed intentions off their customers."
            2. _RuachOo_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "The app has become so bloated over the years its extremely slow, and the unnecessary praising and popups is super annoying. Less clicks = better experience. It also often just freezes for 10seconds before responding again when i open the app"
            3. _LoriLins64_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
<!--/ir-theme-->
